## Checklist
- [ ] The Jira key is in the title or branch name (for example `fix(tasks): keep status on PATCH (LG-1440)`).
- [ ] Tests cover the change, or the PR says why not.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in the code, tests, fixtures or this description.
- [ ] For a bug: the Jira Bug stays open after merge. It goes to Done only after the fix is verified on a deployed environment ([docs/bugs.md](https://github.com/lovablegarden/.github/blob/main/docs/bugs.md)).
